subject: Next steps: GDPR roles, DPA draft & VSQ initiation (ClearBank)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps: GDPR roles, DPA draft & VSQ initiation (ClearBank)

Hi Oliver — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum with procurement: 

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: ClearBank wants to use Redwood to power transaction summarization and customer-support prompts over masked transaction metadata.
- Data types: transaction IDs, masked PANs (tokenized), user display name, timestamps, support notes. No full payment card PANs stored in Redwood.
- Initial region: EU (primary), possible cross-region support later.

Open questions you flagged
1) GDPR role: you asked whether ClearBank or Redwood would be Controller vs Processor for the feature.
2) SCC module preference (UK/EU): procurement needs clarity on which SCC module we propose.
3) SOC 2: you requested our most recent attestation and summary.
4) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): you mentioned procurement will send a standardized form.

Proposed next steps
1) I can share a short DPA draft (Controller–Processor) for your review — unless you confirm ClearBank expects Controller–Controller, in which case we'll map responsibilities differently.
2) Legal (cc'd) will propose SCC module mapping for EU/UK.
3) I'll attach our SOC 2 summary and a short discovery notes doc. Please send the VSQ link and procurement timeline.

Would you prefer the DPA sent as a Word redline-friendly draft (we can accept redlines) or a DocuSign flow?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: discovery-notes-clearbank-20260802.txt
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearbank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearbank.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 15:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps: GDPR roles, DPA draft & VSQ initiation (ClearBank)

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the recap and the call. A few clarifications from our side: 

- GDPR role: ClearBank will be Controller for customer transaction records we own. For the Redwood-hosted feature, we expect Redwood to act as Processor for the processing of transaction metadata and support prompts. We can provide a short data flow diagram if that helps.

- SCC module: Procurement prefers Controller-to-Processor mapping under the standard EU SCC modules. We are in the UK and EU footprint, so confirmation of the module choice for both territories is needed.

- SOC 2: procurement requires SOC 2 Type II evidence (most recent 12‑month period). Please provide a summary and indicate if a full report can be shared under an NDA.

- VSQ: procurement will send the questionnaire — here is the link: https://vsq.clearbank.com/form/4521. If you can nominate a single point of contact for the VSQ, that will speed things up.

We'd prefer the DPA as a Word doc we can redline. Procurement is targeting a decision window of ~2 weeks assuming no major gaps. Happy for a short sync with procurement next week (Tue/Wed preferred).

Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Vendor Risk | ClearBank
oliver.grant@clearbank.com

On Mon, 2 Aug 2026 at 10:12, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Oliver — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum with procurement: ...
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearbank.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: GDPR roles, DPA draft & VSQ initiation (ClearBank)

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear direction. Quick legal note + proposal for how to proceed that should meet procurement requirements while keeping turnaround short: 

1) Roles: Redwood confirms we are prepared to accept Processor status for the described feature. We'll draft a Controller–Processor DPA that reflects the data classes you described. If you can send the short data flow diagram (redacted if needed), we'll map the processing activities precisely.

2) SCC module selection: For EU and UK—our standard is the Controller-to-Processor module set (EU SCCs + UK Addendum where applicable). We'll include explicit cross-border clauses to cover UK→EU transfers and vice versa. If procurement requires a different module variant, flag it and we'll align.

3) SOC 2: attached is a SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). We can share the full Type II report under a mutual NDA; if procurement prefers, we can execute a one-way NDA first and then provide the report.

4) VSQ/process: we can either (A) complete your VSQ link directly (point us to the questionnaire owner) or (B) supply our standard vendor package (policy indexes + SOC 2 summary + environment diagram). To speed things up, nominate the VSQ owner and deadline.

5) Attachments & next steps I'm proposing:
- I'll upload a Word DPA draft (redwood-dpa-draft.docx) to the shared Drive link and cc procurement when it's ready.
- Suggest a procurement sync: Tue 2026-08-10 at 10:00 BST (20 minutes) — pls confirm.

If that works I can get the DPA draft uploaded by EOD today so procurement has something to redline.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-dpa-draft.docx
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearbank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearbank.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 15:23:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps: GDPR roles, DPA draft & VSQ initiation (ClearBank)

Thanks Rishi — that approach sounds good. 

Procurement confirms: we will send the VSQ to the email in cc (procurement@clearbank.com) and expect the VSQ back within 5 business days. We also confirm we prefer a Word DPA redline.

Next steps on our side:
- Procurement will review the SOC 2 summary and will request the full report under NDA if needed.
- We'll share the short data flow diagram by EOD Friday (2026-08-06).
- Procurement would like the DPA draft uploaded to the shared Drive so they can redline directly.

We are good to aim for the Tue 2026-08-10 sync at 10:00 BST — procurement will invite.

Oliver
